basic.name: Standing Ovation
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{value}}% of Guinaifen's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Blazing Welcome
skill.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Guinaifen's ATK to a single enemy and Fire DMG equal to {{adjacent_damage}}% of Guinaifen's ATK to any adjacent enemies, with a 100% base chance to Burn the target and adjacent targets. When Burned, enemies will take a Fire DoT equal to {{burn}}% of Guinaifen's ATK at the beginning of each turn, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Watch This Showstopper
ultimate.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Guinaifen's ATK to all enemies. If the target enemy is currently inflicted with Burn, then their Burn status immediately produces DMG equal to {{detonate}}% of their original DMG.

talent.name: PatrAeon Benefits
talent.description_template: When Guinaifen is on the field, there is a 100% base chance to apply Firekiss to an enemy after their Burn status causes DMG. While inflicted with Firekiss, the enemy receives {{vuln}}% increased DMG, which lasts for 3 turn(s) and can stack up to 3 time(s).

technique.name: Skill Showcase
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals DMG for 4 time(s), dealing Fire DMG equal to 50% of Guinaifen's ATK to a random single enemy target each time, with a 100% base chance of inflicting Firekiss on them.

2.name: High Poles
2.description: Basic ATK has a 80% base chance of inflicting an enemy with a Burn equivalent to that of Skill.

4.name: Bladed Hoop
4.description: When the battle begins, Guinaifen's action advances by 25%.

6.name: Walking on Knives
6.description: Deals 20% more DMG to Burned enemies.

eidolons.name: Slurping Noodles During Handstand
eidolons.description: When Skill is used, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the attacked target enemy's Effect RES by 10% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Brushing Teeth While Whistling
eidolons.description: When an enemy target is being Burned, the DMG multiplier of the Burn status applied by her Basic ATK or Skill increases by 40%.

eidolons.name: Smashing Boulder on Chest
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Blocking Pike with Neck
eidolons.description: Every time the Burn status inflicted by Guinaifen causes DMG, Guinaifen regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: Swallowing Sword to Stomach
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Catching Bullet with Hands
eidolons.description: Increases the stackable Firekiss count by 1.
